cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed (zipped) version of KML files, reducing file size for easier sharing and faster loading.

cards.title: About KML Format
cards.body: KML (Keyhole Markup Language) is an XML format used by Google Earth and Google Maps for geographic data visualization.
